correctness.rationale: The stable Johnson-deletion family defines a matroid: any competing exchange choices cannot all be deleted. For generic scores, when the top rank-r subset is forbidden, the global next-best subset is the unique one-exchange replacement of its least selected member by its greatest unselected member. Conditional ranks distribute its 1/N probability evenly among d=r(n-r) surviving neighbors, giving alpha_B=(1+t(B)/d)/N. Summing t and binom(t,2) yields md and 4q exactly, proving C2. The displayed rank-three triples have respectively zero and one common neighbor of all three forbidden triples; this yields histograms (N-3d+9,3d-24,12,0) and (N-3d+8,3d-21,9,1) and the exact third-difference power-sum identity. For real s>2 positivity follows from the positive third derivative of x^s. Tutte coincidence follows from the rank function, Ehrhart coincidence from disjoint symmetric truncated caps, and entire f-vector coincidence from Ferroni--Schroeter Corollary 2.10 with the same lambda=3,mu=3, with full-dimensionality verified. Exact direct enumeration of 5040 and 40320 orders per example in dimensions 7 and 8, rational moment checks through 11 and basis-exchange/Tutte enumeration passed. Finite checks are supportive, not infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The 2022 paving-matroid Ehrhart paper provides the known hypersimplex truncation and Ehrhart equivalence, while Ferroni--Schroeter (first public 2023) establishes complete face-vector dependence on the deleted circuit-hyperplane count and the distance-two pair statistic. Standard matroid greedy maximization and normal-fan interpretation are acknowledged. Neither inspected work states the exact Euclidean Gaussian normal-cone angle formula or exhibits equal f-vectors and equal two-exposure collision statistics but differing every higher exposure collision statistic. Targeted literature and mathematical-record searches found no covering formulation. A residual risk remains that an unindexed formulation of random greedy basis probabilities already derives an equivalent result.
residual_risks: Broad matroid greedy-basis and normal-fan literature might contain an equivalent unindexed specialization; no universal novelty proof is possible from available searches.
The known face-vector dependence on lambda,mu must not be confused with originality of the angle spectrum.
No independent mathematical verification; exact finite checks do not imply a universal proof by themselves.

value.rationale: The new angle law computes a canonical Euclidean invariant of a well-motivated infinite family of sparse-paving matroid base polytopes. It identifies the exact first angular power that detects higher-order Johnson-neighborhood incidences not encoded by either the Ehrhart polynomial or the whole face vector. The explicit all-n comparison has identical Tutte/Ehrhart/f-vector data, and even identical two-direction collision probability, yet strictly different third and every higher collision probability. This is structural separation of geometric measures, not a routine one-parameter change, arbitrary finite computation or recomputation of a known enumeration table.
